content.title: EXLS Q3 Deep Dive: Data and AI Momentum Shapes Growth, Margins Steady
content.summary: Data analytics and digital solutions company ExlService Holdings (NASDAQ:EXLS) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 12.2% year on year to $529.6 million.
